ASCENDERS_BANE.description: unplayable, Ethereal, Eternal — cannot be removed normally.
ASCENDERS_BANE.name: Ascenders Bane

BOUND.description: host = CHAINS_OF_BINDING_POWER — afflicted cards are drawn up to the power's Amount per turn; only 1 Bound card may be played per turn; all Bound clears at end of your turn.
BOUND.name: Bound

COMPACT.description: hand Status cards become Fuel + Block (card text).
COMPACT.name: Compact

DAZED.description: unplayable, Ethereal — vanishes if unplayed at end of turn. (PersonalHivePower injects Dazed cards into the attacker's draw pile.)
DAZED.name: Dazed

DECAY.description: unplayable; if still in hand at end of turn, deals 2 unpowered damage to its owner (DamageVar 2).
DECAY.name: Decay

DISINTEGRATION.description: cost -1, not generated in combat; when chosen, applies DISINTEGRATION_POWER 6 — lose 6 HP at end of your turn (unpowered), persistent while the power lasts.
DISINTEGRATION.name: Disintegration

DOUBT.description: unplayable; if still in hand at end of turn, applies 1 WEAK_POWER to its owner (first application skips its next duration tick).
DOUBT.name: Doubt

ENTANGLED.description: host = TANGLED_POWER — Attack cards get Entangled; Entangled cards cost +Amount Energy; clears at end of your turn.
ENTANGLED.name: Entangled

FLAK_CANNON.description: exhausts all Status cards, dealing damage per card removed.
FLAK_CANNON.name: Flak Cannon

GALVANIZED.description: host = GALVANIC_POWER (stackable) — Power cards get Galvanized (Amount); playing a Galvanized card deals Amount unpowered damage to its owner.
GALVANIZED.name: Galvanized

HEXED.description: host = HEX_POWER — Hexed cards gain Ethereal keyword while the power exists; clears when the applier dies or the power is removed.
HEXED.name: Hexed

ITERATION.description: ITERATION_POWER — extra draw the first time you draw a Status card each turn.
ITERATION.name: Iteration

MIND_ROT.description: cost -1; when chosen, applies MIND_ROT_POWER 1 — draw 1 fewer card per turn.
MIND_ROT.name: Mind Rot

NORMALITY.description: unplayable; while it is in your hand, after you have played 3 cards this turn you can play no more cards (limit 3 plays/turn).
NORMALITY.name: Normality

REGRET.description: unplayable; at end of turn, if in hand, deals unblockable unpowered damage to owner equal to the number of cards in hand (counted at turn end).
REGRET.name: Regret

RINGING.description: host = RINGING_POWER — a Ringing card is unplayable once any card has been played this turn; clears at end of your turn.
RINGING.name: Ringing

ROCKET_PUNCH.description: becomes free when a Status card is created.
ROCKET_PUNCH.name: Rocket Punch

SLIMED.description: cost 1; on play draw 1 card, Exhausts.
SLIMED.name: Slimed

SLOTH.description: cost -1; when chosen, applies SLOTH_POWER 3 — play at most 3 cards per turn (counter resets at your turn start; display shows cards played this turn).
SLOTH.name: Sloth

SMOG.description: host = SMOGGY_POWER — Skill cards get Smog after you play a Skill; Smog cards are unplayable while the power exists; clears at end of your turn.
SMOG.name: Smog

SMOKESTACK.description: SMOKESTACK_POWER — damages all enemies when a Status card is created.
SMOKESTACK.name: Smokestack

TAINTED.description: host = TAINTED_POWER — attacks against the power owner deal +Amount damage; the power itself is removed at end of Enemy side turn. (VitalSparkPower afflicts player Skill cards with Tainted and applies TaintedPower when a Tainted card is played.)
TAINTED.name: Tainted

TOXIC.description: cost 1, Exhausts; if still in hand at end of turn, deals 5 unpowered damage to its owner (DamageVar 5).
TOXIC.name: Toxic

TRASH_TO_TREASURE.description: TRASH_TO_TREASURE_POWER — channels a random Orb when a Status card is created.
TRASH_TO_TREASURE.name: Trash To Treasure

WASTE_AWAY.description: cost -1; when chosen, applies WASTE_AWAY_POWER 1 — max Energy reduced by 1.
WASTE_AWAY.name: Waste Away

WOUND.description: unplayable; pure deck clog. 3 Wounds in hand through end of turn dealt ZERO HP damage — no Infection-class EOT tax; the "pure deck clog" classification holds.
WOUND.name: Wound
